messages.author: 9fd016d8644fc0c5
messages.subject: Re: Schott Reflective slides COMMERCIAL response
parts:
Dear Jacob,

There is another yahoo groups that is probably a better place to ask
your question:

http://tech.groups.yahoo.com/group/microarray/

However, there are a number of publications citing the use of the
SCHOTT Nexterion reflective (HiSens) slides:

Expression of microRNA-221 is progressively reduced in aggressive
prostate cancer and metastasis and predicts clinical recurrence
Martin Spahn, Susanne Kneitz, Claus-Jürgen Scholz, Stenger Nico,
Thomas Rüdiger, Philipp Ströbel, Hubertus Riedmiller, Burkhard Kneitz
Doi; 10.1002/ijc.24715

Optimization of fluorescence enhancement for silicon-based microarrays
Vanessa Marino, Clelia Galati, Claudio Arnone
J. Biomed. Opt., Vol. 13, 054060 (2008);
doi:10.1117/1.2992142

Redkar RJ, Schultz NA, Scheumann V, Burzio LA, Haines DE, Metwalli E,
Becker O, Conzone SD
Signal and sensitivity enhancement through optical interference
coating for DNA and protein
microarray applications
J Biomol Tech. 2006; 17(2):122-130

Ambion TechNotes. Aug 2006;13(3):17
miRNA Expression Profiling
http://www.ambion.com/techlib/tn/133/AmbionTechNotes13_3.pdf

Regards,

Alistair Rees

Nexterion - Microarray Solutions
SCHOTT Technical Glass Solutions GmbH
Otto-Schott-Strasse 13,
D-07745 Jena,
Germany

www.schott.com/nexterion
